description: This file provides function declarations for different merge strategies involved in a three-way merge process, specifically using the ORT (Ongoing Recursive Three-way) algorithm. It includes wrappers for non-recursive, recursive with ancestor consolidation, and generic merge operations, all related to merge options, commits, and trees.

methods.name: merge_ort_nonrecursive
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge, mimicking a previous function merge_trees().

methods.name: merge_ort_recursive
methods.description: Performs a recursive, rename-detecting merge with ancestor consolidation, mimicking merge_recursive().

methods.name: merge_ort_generic
methods.description: Performs a generic, rename-detecting merge, with optional multiple merge bases, mimicking merge_recursive_generic().
